result.title: Spe3DUp: Faithful Trajectory Distillation for Fast Image-to-3D Generation
result.summary: Recent 3D generative models can produce high-quality meshes with complex structures and fine geometric details, with broad applications in games, film, and digital design. However, high-quality generation typically relies on long multi-step sampling processes that repeatedly evaluate large networks, leading to long inference times. At the same time, reference-driven tasks such as game-asset reconstruction and product digitization demand close correspondence to the input image: generated geometry must faithfully reconstruct the specific reference object. Acceleration must therefore reduce sampling computation while preserving the model's ability to reconstruct that object. To enable fast and faithful 3D generation, we introduce Spe3DUp, a coarse-to-fine framework based on Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD). FTD directly supervises few-step students with the teacher's input-conditioned denoising trajectories to preserve its generation behavior. We apply FTD separately to coarse geometry generation and geometric refinement, compressing both sampling processes while maintaining correspondence to the reference input. We further accelerate the complete mesh-generation pipeline with efficient geometry decoding and parallel remeshing. Experiments show that Spe3DUp maintains geometric quality and input correspondence close to those of the teacher, accelerates the coarse and refinement DiTs by 10.0x and 19.9x, respectively, and achieves a 7.7x end-to-end speedup over the original teacher pipeline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Spe3DUp，用「忠实轨迹蒸馏」把教师模型在给定图像条件下的去噪轨迹直接作为少步学生的监督，分别压缩粗几何生成与几何细化两个 DiT 采样过程，并配合高效几何解码与并行 remeshing 加速整体网格生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 图像到 3D 生成本身不属主线，但其以教师中间轨迹监督少步学生、压缩多步采样并保持输入对应性的做法，或可供核查 LVR 中多步 latent 推理轨迹的蒸馏式监督与计算压缩。
